title: 2-Unpredictability of XOR and CENC KDFs
summary: The paper proves 2-unpredictability for KD0 and KD1 but leaves proving the same property for the XOR and CENC KDF constructions unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Prove that the XOR and CENC KDF constructions are $2$-unpredictable.

scope.domain: Unpredictability analysis of block-cipher-based key-derivation constructions.
parameters: 2, the target value of the unpredictability parameter
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove 2-unpredictability for both the XOR and CENC KDF constructions.

citations.label: Revisiting AES-GCM-SIV: Multi-user Security, Faster Key Derivation, and Better Bounds

progress.summary: The paper proves 2-unpredictability for KD0 and KD1, then suggests establishing the same property for XOR and CENC. It proceeds with natural, 2-unpredictable KDFs without supplying those proofs.
citation_labels: Priyanka Bose et al., Revisiting AES-GCM-SIV: Multi-user Security, Faster Key Derivation, and Better Bounds
